messages:
Alex Kim: heads up — after the int4 bring-up we’re seeing a spike in labeler backlog for short prompts (<=40 tokens). can we triage before it blocks canaries? :eyes:
Priya Singh: ugh. is it noisy duplicates or true edgecases? any quick stats?
Alex Kim: quick peek — 60% of new failures are near-duplicates of existing golden items, plus ~15% that look like paraphrase drift. sample of 200: 122 dup-ish, 30 paraphrase, rest are clear new.
Jorge Morales: seems like dedupe needs to run earlier in the ingest pipeline. we currently run fuzzyhash post-sampling. we could add a lightweight fingerprint step pre-batch to drop obvious dups.
Sam T: +1. what’s the fingerprint threshold you want? we don’t want to filter novel paraphrases.
Priya Singh: propose two tiers: exact-fingerprint (drop) + soft-sim (flag for review). exact fingerprint = md5 of normalized prompt (lower, strip punctuation, collapse spaces). soft-sim = simscore > 0.92 on embed.
Alex Kim: that aligns with my view. can LabelBot kick off a dry-run against the last 7 days and annotate counts?
LabelBot: starting dry-run job job-17611122-dryrun against ingest-7d. will report counts to thread when done.
Jorge Morales: if dry-run shows >40% drop we should also notify label ops and expand the batch size by +30% to burn down backlog.
Sam T: adding a sampling snippet — this is what I used for a quick prefilter (feel free to copy):
```sql
-- prefilter: normalized exact fingerprint
WITH norm AS (SELECT id, lower(regexp_replace(prompt, '[\\p{Punct}]', '', 'g')) AS p_norm FROM raw_ingest)
SELECT id FROM norm WHERE md5(p_norm) NOT IN (SELECT md5(p_norm) FROM golden_items);
```
Priya Singh: looks good. for soft-sim we’ll use embed-center with Faiss — I’ll queue a job: "soft-sim-flag-176111" to mark items for manual review rather than dropping.
Alex Kim: also need a golden refresh plan: if dry-run reduces dup rate, we’ll open a 1-week micro-golden update to replace low-coverage anchors (priority: safety/longform fallbacks).
Jorge Morales: timeline? label ops availability?
Priya Singh: label ops said they can take a micro-golden wave next Tue/Wed (slot reserved). we should prepare the curated set by Monday EOD.
Sam T: I’ll prepare the dedupe pipeline PR: branch name `prefilter/fingerprint-softsim-176111`. will include config knobs for thresholds and a toggle for dry-run.
Alex Kim: perfect. post dry-run summary here and if counts OK we flip toggle and push micro-golden list to label ops. thx everyone :rocket:
